digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge preview/sync and reconcile command routing
propositions: Canonical bridge preview must execute a single ordinary dry-run differ pass and emit one manifest containing both arbitrated plan entries and exact field-level drift from that same pass without invoking reconcile-check.
Canonical preview must remain lock-free by bypassing pass-lock acquisition, purge, stealing, and release while preserving existing repository and collateral state integrity.

Legacy rebar reconcile --mode reconcile-check must retain its all-cached-ticket loader, unarbitrated _compare_pair semantics, lock-free execution, diagnostic JSON artifact, and output behavior unchanged.

The argparse parser must use allow_abbrev=False to reject prefix abbreviations and unknown options with invocation error 2 before any repository access, lock operations, or mutations, while documented options remain valid.

Canonical preview and canonical sync must emit the same field-comparable manifest envelope, and canonical uncapped live must retain a manifest with exact applied/failed tally while legacy uncapped LIVE retains its historical tally-only/no-manifest contract.

Legacy --mode live, library reconcile, MCP reconcile, older workflows, and external helpers must maintain their historical observable behavior including capped/bootstrap applied/deferred partitions unchanged.
